narration:0:1061004001:2.text: After bidding farewell to Sinbad, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brings the exhausted duo back to Holistone...
narration:0:1061004001:2.male: After bidding farewell to Sinbad, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brings the exhausted duo back to Holistone...
narration:0:1061004001:2.female: After bidding farewell to Sinbad, <style="stress"><player_name></style> brings the exhausted duo back to Holistone...

say:5:1061004003:0.text: Thank you all, really. Not just for helping us find Aquarius, but for taking such good care of us.
say:5:1061004003:0.source_cn: 谢谢你们，不仅帮忙找到了阿葵亚，还盛情款待我们……

choice_prompt:6:1061004003.text: Thank you all, really. Not just for helping us find Aquarius, but for taking such good care of us.
choice_prompt:6:1061004003.source_cn: 谢谢你们，不仅帮忙找到了阿葵亚，还盛情款待我们……

say:7:1061004004:1.text: Without your help... I honestly don't know how we would've made it.
say:7:1061004004:1.source_cn: 如果不是遇到你们，真难想象我们该怎么办。

say:8:1061004006:1.text: Lucy! Try these glowy fruits! They're crazy good!
say:8:1061004006:1.source_cn: 露西！来尝尝这盘亮晶晶的果子！

say:9:1061004007:1.text: Whoa, what is this flavor?! We don't have anything like this back in Fiore!
say:9:1061004007:1.source_cn: 唔……美味！这果子叫什么，我们那边没见过。

say:10:1061004008:0.text: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.
say:10:1061004008:0.male: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.
say:10:1061004008:0.female: They're glowfly fruit. <style="stress"><player_name></style> showed us how to magically enhance their flavor.

say:11:1061004009:0.text: We better eat as many as we can—no way we're finding these back home!
say:11:1061004009:0.source_cn: 这么难得，那要多吃点！回去可就吃不着了！

say:12:1061004010:1.text: Let's pack some for the guild!
say:12:1061004010:1.source_cn: 我们可以带一些回公会给其他人尝尝。

say:13:1061004011:1.text: Guild? Oh right—I was going to find you for a job.
say:13:1061004011:1.source_cn: 公会？说起来我本来是叫你一起去做任务的……

say:14:1061004012:1.text: And I told Happy to meet us there! He's probably worried sick!
say:14:1061004012:1.source_cn: 我告诉哈比在公会集合的，他还在那等着我们呢！

say:15:1061004013:1.source_cn: 露西，我们要去找哈比！别让它担心！

say:17:1061004015:1.text: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:17:1061004015:1.source_cn: 等一下，至少让我向大家表达一下感谢！尤其是<style...
say:17:1061004015:1.male: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:17:1061004015:1.female: Wait! At least let me thank everyone properly! Especially <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:18:1061004016:1.text: Things could've gone so wrong today... but thanks to all of you, they didn't.
say:18:1061004016:1.source_cn: 今天，多亏了你们，一切都有惊无险。

say:19:1061004017:1.text: Natsu and I will never forget your kindness.
say:19:1061004017:1.source_cn: 我和纳兹，非常感谢大家！

say:20:1061004018:1.text: Yeah! Not only did we find Aquarius, but we ate like kings!
say:20:1061004018:1.source_cn: 对，不仅顺利找到了阿葵亚，还能吃到这么好吃的东西！

say:21:1061004019:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!
say:21:1061004019:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!
say:21:1061004019:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're the best! You might not wear our mark, but you're Fairy Tail through and through!

say:22:1061004020:1.text: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
say:22:1061004020:1.source_cn: 没错，等我们回去了也会告诉大家，在伊索米亚的大陆上，有...
say:22:1061004020:1.male: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
say:22:1061004020:1.female: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!

choice_prompt:23:1061004020.text: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.source_cn: 没错，等我们回去了也会告诉大家，在伊索米亚的大陆上，有个叫<style=stress><player_name></style>的大魔法师，是个了不起的好人！
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.male: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!
choice_prompt:23:1061004020.female: We'll make sure everyone back home hears about <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the legendary mage of Esperia!

say:24:1061004021:1.text: *Sigh* Yeah... I know we only just met, but... it's already hard saying goodbye.
say:24:1061004021:1.source_cn: 唉……明明才认识不久，一想到要和你们说再见，总觉得很不...

say:25:1061004022:0.text: You should come visit our world sometime!
say:25:1061004022:0.source_cn: 什么时候也来我们的世界玩吧！

say:26:1061004023:1.text: The guild would love to have you!

say:27:1061004024:1.text: Actually... I've been curious about something...
say:27:1061004024:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我一直有个心底的疑问……

say:28:1061004025:1.text: When you first came to Holistone, you mentioned "Fairy Tail". Can you tell me more about it?
say:28:1061004025:1.source_cn: 你们刚到圣石镇时也提到过妖精的尾巴这个名字，那到底是怎...

say:29:1061004026:1.text: Like I said earlier, it's less of a guild, more of a family! But let me expand on that.
say:29:1061004026:1.source_cn: 与其说公会，不如说是个大家庭！

say:30:1061004027:1.text: Our guildmates aren't just comrades in name—they're bonds of the heart, people you can trust unconditionally.
say:30:1061004027:1.source_cn: 是的，这里的家人不是言语上，是心之所属，可以无条件信任...

say:31:1061004028:1.text: Through joy and sorrow, we stand together.
say:31:1061004028:1.source_cn: 欢乐也好，痛苦也罢，都会相互陪伴。

say:32:1061004029:1.text: No matter where we go, we're never alone. We can always face tomorrow with hope in our hearts!
say:32:1061004029:1.source_cn: 无论到哪里都不再孤身一人，我们可以随时心怀希望，奔向明天！

say:33:1061004030:1.text: It's a place where the adventure begins, carried by the song of fairies.
say:33:1061004030:1.source_cn: 那是个，随时能和妖精的歌声一起启程的地方！

choice_prompt:35:1061004031.source_cn: 总之，有伙伴的地方，就是妖精的尾巴！

say:38:1061004032:0.text: Indeed. A place where all are welcome, just like this place.
say:38:1061004032:0.source_cn: 没错，像是和神秘屋一样，能把大家都聚齐的温暖的地方。

say:39:1061004033:0.text: Anyway, Lucy, how do we get back to the guild? Got any ideas?
say:39:1061004033:0.source_cn: 说起来，露西，我们怎样回公会呢？你有什么办法吗？

say:43:1061004035:0.text: The gate I opened only connects to the Spirit World. Sending you two back to Earth Land will require another method.
say:43:1061004035:0.source_cn: 我打开的星灵之门只能回星灵界，要把你们送回阿斯兰特需要...

say:44:1061004036:0.text: What?! Not even Aquarius can do it?! Are we stuck here forever?!
say:44:1061004036:0.source_cn: 什么……连阿葵亚也没有办法吗……那我们岂不是回不去了！

say:47:1061004037:0.text: Actually, I meant to say this earlier—I tried tracking the magical energy around you two, and it led me to a really distant space. I think... that might be your original world.
say:47:1061004037:0.source_cn: 我其实刚才就想说，我试着追溯你们身上的魔力，追溯到一个...

say:48:1061004038:0.text: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?
say:48:1061004038:0.source_cn: 但我的魔力还不足以开启链接两个空间的传送门。<styl...
say:48:1061004038:0.male: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?
say:48:1061004038:0.female: But I don't have enough magic power to open a portal that spans two dimensions. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you think... you could help me?

choice_prompt:49:1061004031.source_cn: 总之，有伙伴的地方，就是妖精的尾巴！

say:50:1061004039:0.text: T-The portal opened just like that...? What was I even stressing over earlier...?
say:50:1061004039:0.source_cn: 传、传送门就这样被打开了……？所以我刚才在苦恼什么……

say:51:1061004040:0.text: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!
say:51:1061004040:0.male: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!
say:51:1061004040:0.female: As expected of <style="stress"><player_name></style>—you made it look easy! Natsu, Lucy, hurry! The portal won't stay open for long!

say:52:1061004041:0.text: We're already saying goodbye? That was way too fast!
say:52:1061004041:0.source_cn: 呃， 这么快就要和各位说再见了！

say:53:1061004042:0.text: Farewell... *Sniff* I hope we'll meet again.
say:53:1061004042:0.source_cn: 再见……呜呜……希望还能和大家见面。

narration:55:1061004043:0.text: Aquarius, Lucy, and Natsu step through the gate, vanishing from sight.
narration:55:1061004043:0.source_cn: 阿葵亚、露西与纳兹走进了星灵之门，消失在众人的视野中

narration:56:1061004044:0.text: The Mystical House feels quieter without Natsu and Lucy. But before long, Valen's jokes break the silence—filling the room with warmth and laughter once more.
narration:56:1061004044:0.source_cn: 神秘屋少了纳兹与露西的身影显得有些落寂，不过很快被维伦...

narration:57:1061004045:0.text: Cassadee's diary ends today on a rare note—nothing about magic this time. Instead, she writes:
narration:57:1061004045:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂今天的日记结尾难得与讨论魔法无关，这样写道：

narration:58:1061004046:0.text: Every journey's an adventure when you've got friends you trust. With them by your side, there's nothing to be afraid of.
narration:58:1061004046:0.source_cn: 每次启程都是一次华丽的冒险，有信赖的伙伴在身旁的时候，...

narration:59:1061004047:0.text: So keep that hope close, and head out again when you're ready!

narration:60:1061004048:0.text: You're always welcome back, Natsu and Lucy.
narration:60:1061004048:0.source_cn: 随时欢迎你们回来，纳兹，露西

choice:49:0:1.text: I'll use my magic to open a portal!
choice:49:0:1.male: I'll use my magic to open a portal!
choice:49:0:1.female: I'll use my magic to open a portal!

say:62:1061004005:1.text: Are we doing goodbye speeches already? I'm not emotionally prepared!
say:62:1061004005:1.source_cn: 啊，要提前说告别语了吗？我还没准备好……
